title_en: Law of the People's Republic of China on the People's Bank of China

articles.content_en: This Law is enacted for the purpose of establishing the status of the People's Bank of China, defining its functions, ensuring the correct formulation and implementation of the national monetary policy, establishing and perfecting a macro-control system of the central bank, and maintaining financial stability.

The People's Bank of China is the central bank of the People's Republic of China.
The People's Bank of China shall, under the leadership of the State Council, formulate and implement monetary policies, prevent and mitigate financial risks, and maintain financial stability.
The objective of monetary policy is to maintain the stability of the currency value and thereby promote economic growth.

Decisions of the People's Bank of China on the annual money supply, interest rates, exchange rates and other important matters as prescribed by the State Council shall be implemented after being submitted to and approved by the State Council.
Decisions of the People's Bank of China on other matters concerning monetary policies, other than those prescribed in the preceding paragraph, shall be implemented immediately after they are made, and shall be reported to the State Council for the record.
The People's Bank of China shall submit a work report to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the situation of monetary policies and the operation of the financial industry.

The People's Bank of China shall, under the leadership of the State Council, independently implement monetary policies, perform its functions and conduct business according to law, and shall be free from interference by local governments, government departments at all levels, public organizations or individuals.
The entire capital of the People's Bank of China shall be contributed by the State and shall be owned by the State.
The State Council shall establish a coordination mechanism for financial supervision and administration, and the specific measures shall be formulated by the State Council.

The People's Bank of China shall have one Governor and a number of Deputy Governors.
The candidate for the Governor of the People's Bank of China shall be nominated by the Premier of the State Council and decided by the National People's Congress; when the National People's Congress is not in session, the decision shall be made by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and the Governor shall be appointed or removed by the President of the People's Republic of China. The Deputy Governors of the People's Bank of China shall be appointed or removed by the Premier of the State Council.

The People's Bank of China shall implement a system under which the Governor assumes overall responsibility. The Governor shall direct the work of the People's Bank of China, and the Deputy Governors shall assist the Governor in his work.

The People's Bank of China shall establish a Monetary Policy Committee. The functions, composition and working procedures of the Monetary Policy Committee shall be prescribed by the State Council and reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for the record.
The Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China shall play an important role in the national macroeconomic regulation and control, and the formulation and adjustment of monetary policies.

The People's Bank of China shall establish branches as its dispatched bodies as required for the performance of its functions. The People's Bank of China shall exercise unified leadership and management over its branches.
The branches of the People's Bank of China shall, under the authorization of the People's Bank of China, maintain financial stability in their respective jurisdictions and undertake relevant business.

The Governor, Deputy Governors and other staff members of the People's Bank of China shall devote themselves to their duties, shall not abuse their powers, engage in malpractice for personal gain, and shall not hold concurrent positions in any financial institution, enterprise or foundation.

The Governor, Deputy Governors and other staff members of the People's Bank of China shall keep state secrets according to law, and have the obligation to keep secrets for the financial institutions and parties concerned relating to the performance of their functions.

The legal tender of the People's Republic of China is Renminbi. Renminbi shall be used to pay all public and private debts within the territory of the People's Republic of China, and no unit or individual may refuse to accept it.
The unit of Renminbi is Yuan, and the fractional units of Renminbi are Jiao and Fen.

Renminbi shall be uniformly printed and issued by the People's Bank of China.
When issuing a new type of Renminbi, the People's Bank of China shall announce the issuing date, denomination, pattern, design and specifications.

It is prohibited to counterfeit or alter Renminbi. It is prohibited to sell or purchase counterfeit or altered Renminbi. It is prohibited to transport, hold or use counterfeit or altered Renminbi. It is prohibited to intentionally damage Renminbi. It is prohibited to illegally use Renminbi designs on promotional materials, publications or other goods.
No unit or individual may print or issue token certificates to replace Renminbi in circulation in the market.

Mutilated or soiled Renminbi shall be exchanged in accordance with the regulations of the People's Bank of China, and the People's Bank of China shall be responsible for their withdrawal and destruction.

The People's Bank of China shall establish a Renminbi Issue Depository, and shall establish branch depositories in its branches. The allocation of Renminbi issue funds by a branch depository shall be handled according to the allocation order of the superior depository. No unit or individual may use the issue funds in violation of the regulations.
The People's Bank of China shall act as the fiscal agent in accordance with the provisions of laws and administrative regulations.

The People's Bank of China may, on behalf of the financial department of the State Council, organize the issuance and redemption of government bonds and other government securities to various financial institutions.
The People's Bank of China may, as needed, open accounts for banking financial institutions, but may not overdraw the accounts of banking financial institutions.

The People's Bank of China shall organize or assist in organizing a clearing system among banking financial institutions, coordinate clearing matters among banking financial institutions, and provide clearing services. The specific measures shall be formulated by the People's Bank of China.
The People's Bank of China shall, jointly with the banking regulatory authority under the State Council, formulate rules for payment and settlement.

The People's Bank of China may, as required by the implementation of monetary policies, decide on the amount, term, interest rate and method of loans to commercial banks, but the term of such loans shall not exceed one year.
The People's Bank of China may not overdraw on the government finance, and may not directly subscribe to or underwrite government bonds or other government securities.

The People's Bank of China may not provide loans to local governments, government departments at all levels, non-bank financial institutions or other units and individuals, except that the State Council decides that the People's Bank of China may provide loans to specific non-bank financial institutions.
The People's Bank of China may not provide guarantees to any unit or individual.

The People's Bank of China shall, according to law, monitor the operation of the financial market, implement macroeconomic regulation over the financial market, and promote its coordinated development.

The People's Bank of China may, as required by the implementation of monetary policies and the maintenance of financial stability, propose to the banking regulatory authority under the State Council to inspect and supervise banking financial institutions. The banking regulatory authority under the State Council shall give a reply within thirty days from the date of receipt of the proposal.

When a banking financial institution encounters payment difficulties that may give rise to financial risks, the People's Bank of China shall, for the purpose of maintaining financial stability and with the approval of the State Council, have the power to inspect and supervise the banking financial institution.

The People's Bank of China shall, as required by the performance of its functions, have the power to require banking financial institutions to submit necessary balance sheets, income statements and other financial accounting, statistical statements and data.
The People's Bank of China shall establish a mechanism for sharing supervision information with the banking regulatory authority under the State Council and other financial regulatory authorities under the State Council.

The People's Bank of China shall be responsible for the unified compilation of national financial statistical data and statements, and shall publish them in accordance with the relevant regulations of the State.
The People's Bank of China shall establish and perfect an auditing and inspection system for its own system and strengthen its internal supervision and management.

The People's Bank of China shall implement an independent financial budget management system.
The budget of the People's Bank of China shall, after being examined by the financial department of the State Council, be incorporated into the central budget and be subject to the supervision of the financial department of the State Council over the implementation of the budget.

The net profit of the People's Bank of China for each fiscal year, after deducting the expenditures for that year and setting aside the general reserve according to the proportion verified by the financial department of the State Council, shall be turned over to the central finance in full.
Losses of the People's Bank of China shall be covered by allocations from the central finance.

The financial revenues and expenditures and accounting affairs of the People's Bank of China shall comply with the laws, administrative regulations and the uniform financial and accounting systems of the State, and shall be subject to the audit and supervision conducted separately by the auditing authority and the financial department of the State Council according to law.

The People's Bank of China shall, within three months after the end of each fiscal year, compile a balance sheet, an income statement and related financial accounting statements, and prepare an annual report, and publish them in accordance with the relevant regulations of the State.
The fiscal year of the People's Bank of China shall begin on January 1 and end on December 31 of the Gregorian calendar.

Whoever counterfeits or alters Renminbi, sells counterfeit or altered Renminbi, or knowingly transports counterfeit or altered Renminbi, if the act constitutes a crime, shall be investigated for criminal liability according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, the public security organ shall impose a detention of not more than 15 days and a fine of not more than 10,000 Yuan.

Whoever purchases counterfeit or altered Renminbi, or knowingly holds or uses counterfeit or altered Renminbi, if the act constitutes a crime, shall be investigated for criminal liability according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, the public security organ shall impose a detention of not more than 15 days and a fine of not more than 10,000 Yuan.

Where Renminbi designs are illegally used on promotional materials, publications or other goods, the People's Bank of China shall order the correction, destroy the illegally used Renminbi designs, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine of not more than 50,000 Yuan.

Where token certificates are printed or issued to replace Renminbi in circulation in the market, the People's Bank of China shall order the cessation of the illegal act and impose a fine of not more than 200,000 Yuan.

Where any of the acts listed in Article 32 of this Law violates the relevant provisions and there are penalty provisions in the relevant laws and administrative regulations, the penalty shall be imposed in accordance with such provisions; where there is no penalty provision in the relevant laws and administrative regulations, the People's Bank of China shall, depending on the circumstances, give a warning, confiscate the illegal gains, and if the illegal gains are more than 500,000 Yuan, impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains or the illegal gains are less than 500,000 Yuan, impose a fine of not less than 500,000 Yuan but not more than 2,000,000 Yuan; with respect to the directors, senior officers and other persons directly responsible, give a warning and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 Yuan but not more than 500,000 Yuan; if the act constitutes a crime, the criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

A party that is dissatisfied with an administrative penalty may institute an administrative action in accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

Where a local government, a government department at any level, a public organization or an individual compels the People's Bank of China or its staff members to provide loans or guarantees in violation of the provisions of Article 30 of this Law, the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be given administrative sanctions according to law; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if losses are caused, they shall bear partial or full liability for compensation.

Where a staff member of the People's Bank of China divulges state secrets or trade secrets known to him, if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, administrative sanctions shall be given according to law.

Where a staff member of the People's Bank of China commits embezzlement, bribery, malpractice for personal gain, abuse of power, or dereliction of duty, if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, administrative sanctions shall be given according to law.

For the purposes of this Law, banking financial institutions mean financial institutions that absorb deposits from the public, including commercial banks, urban credit cooperatives, rural credit cooperatives, etc., established within the territory of the People's Republic of China, as well as policy banks.
Financial asset management companies, trust and investment companies, finance companies, financial leasing companies and other financial institutions established within the territory of the People's Republic of China with the approval of the banking regulatory authority under the State Council shall be subject to the provisions of this Law concerning banking financial institutions.
This Law shall come into force as of the date of its promulgation.
